title: feat(spec,runtime): a package export carries its namespace and dependencies, so a reinstalled .custom pair keeps both (#29617)

Fixes #29617

Clause-②: yes (widening)

Skills-docs: none — both keys are written by the export door from the registry row and read by the install door; no author writes them, and `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` already sends the reader to the pair's export, which now reinstalls whole

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`GET /packages/:id/export` 的导出清单新增两个可选固定键 `namespace` 与 `dependencies`,从包的注册表行读取并写出;spec 的 `PackageExportManifestSchema` 同步声明这两个键(形状直接复用安装清单 `ManifestSchema` 的同名键)。
- 为什么改:导出再经 install-local 重装时,`.custom` 配对包丢了命名空间(落到 `custom`)和对基础包的依赖;实测重装直接被 ADR-0146 D2 覆盖闸门拒绝 `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`。
- 风险与回滚:只多写两个键,行里没有就不写;旧导出照旧可装。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 中 `assemblePackageManifest` 末尾新增的两行;`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` 的两个新键;dogfood 新测试 `package-export-reinstall-custom-pair.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/package-export-reinstall-custom-pair.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 3 条全绿(源端导出带两键、目标端重装 200、重装后注册表行命名空间为 `showcase_custom` 且依赖指向 showcase)。
- 需要你做的:无。两个键名已获批准(见下方 Name approval),triage 的契约复审 PASS 在案,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec.** `PackageExportManifestSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`) declares two more optional fixed keys, `namespace` and `dependencies`. Each is the install manifest's own declaration, `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` / `ManifestSchema.shape.dependencies`, re-described for the export, so an export refuses exactly what an install would. The schema stays open for the per-type collections.
- **Runtime.** `assemblePackageManifest` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) writes both from the package's registry row (`registry.getPackage(id).manifest`), as the row declares them, and writes neither when the row declares none. `dependencies` is a copy of the row's map.
- Generated: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (two rows) and `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx`.
- One changeset, `@objectstack/spec` minor and `@objectstack/runtime` minor (the kind is `added`, on both packages the diff moves).

## Why

Measured by the filer through the real door on `81cd9eb0`, and again here by ablation on this branch: the export answered the pair's items with `id`, `name`, `version`, and none of the two keys its registry row holds. Reinstalled through `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, the pair had no namespace (the door derives `custom` from the id) and no edge to its base. The edge is what orders the pair after its base (ADR-0141 D5) and what admits its `overrides` declarations at the managed install (ADR-0146 D2). With the emission ablated, the round-trip pin's install answers:

```text
403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE — 'dashboard/showcase_revenue_pulse' declares an override of 'com.example.showcase', which is outside the dependency closure of 'com.example.showcase.custom'. Declare a dependency on 'com.example.showcase' in the `dependencies` of 'com.example.showcase.custom''s manifest, or remove `overrides` (ADR-0146 D2). Nothing was installed or written.
```

This also unblocks the server slice of #28914 (the whole-ontology export), which composes this per-package export.

## Out of scope

- **`type`.** The export still does not write `type`. Adding it alone would not make the export a `POST /packages` body.
- **The flat-collection refusal of `POST /api/v1/packages`.** That door still refuses an export (400: no `type`, flat collection keys). It is not a reinstall door; install-local is the door that reinstalls an export.

## Name approval

The maintainer approved the two key names `namespace` and `dependencies` on `PackageExportManifestSchema` as named: Warren chose 「全部批准」 on the decision card 「六个命名/措辞全部按推荐批准吗？」 (item 6), project thread "Decide pending spec name approvals", 2026-11-03T00:08Z. Seat pointer on #29617: comment 6591852561.

## Tests

- **Round trip, two real showcase boots** (new `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-reinstall-custom-pair.dogfood.test.ts`). Source boot: the ensure door creates `com.example.showcase.custom`, a dashboard override is saved into it and published, and the pair's export carries the `namespace` (`showcase_custom`) and `dependencies` (`com.example.showcase`) its registry row declares (the row is the control). Target boot, a fresh showcase with install-local mounted: the export installs 200, and the reinstalled pair's registry row declares the same namespace and the same edge to the showcase.
- **Door unit pin** (new `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-registry-row-keys.test.ts`): the real dispatcher over a registry double. The pair's export carries both keys (a copy of the row's map) and parses as `PackageExportManifestSchema`; a row declaring neither writes neither; `type` stays out.
- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`, a new block at the end of the file): a pair's export parses and keeps both keys; both are optional; each refuses what an install would (`1crm`, `Crm`, a non-string range, an array); each describe names its source and the ADRs and no tracker id.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, runtime rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs runtime 'manifest.namespace = namespace' --absent` passed): the dogfood file went 3 of 3 red (source export lacks `namespace`; install `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` as quoted above; target row `404`), the door pin 2 of 3 red. Restore proved `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty; runtime rebuilt, preflight found the marker in 2 built files, and the dogfood file was 3 of 3 green again.

## Acceptance notes

- **Serial after PR #29521** (`withheldMaps`, same schema), which merged while this branch was open. The new keys sit between `version` and `label`, apart from #29521's lines; `main` was merged in at `d280265b`, its two generated artifacts (`authorable-surface/api.json`, `package-lifecycle.mdx`) regenerated from the merged tree rather than text-merged, and the docblock now counts "the seven fixed keys below" (the existing spec test title follows). The new spec tests are a block at the end of `package-lifecycle.test.ts`.
- No `protocol.ts` file is touched (freeze until 2026-11-03 06:00Z).
- `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` needs no row: `namespace` and `dependencies` are already classified there as `ManifestSchema` keys.
